env.source: Apple shell_cmds-329, FreeBSD's env, its getopt string
env.how: Read from env/env.c at apple-oss-distributions/shell_cmds tag shell_cmds-329 (gh api 'repos/apple-oss-distributions/shell_cmds/contents/env/env.c?ref=shell_cmds-329'): the __APPLE__ getopt string -0C:iP:S:u:v, each letter followed by a colon taking a value; getopt takes no long option and abbreviates none. Its usage() prints the same letters. The string also lists - as a letter, which clears the environment as -i does, so a word such as --unset is that letter bundled with others; no row spells it, since -- alone ends the options, and the hub guard's reading of it is issue 2622.
